analysis_plan.answer_objective: Identify and present all instances of disputes, arguments, conflicts, or fights that relate to schools, schooling, education, or school-related matters.
answer_requirements: Present each identified fight or dispute with its supporting evidence and source ID
Describe the nature of the conflict and how it relates to school or education
Identify the parties involved where evidence permits
Note the form of the fight (e.g., verbal, physical, written exchange) where discernible
Flag any uncertainty about whether the dispute is truly school-related or whether the exchange constitutes a fight

concepts.definition: Disagreements, arguments, conflicts, disputes, or confrontations between people, which may be verbal, physical, or indirect in nature.
concepts.label: fights
manifestations: conflicts expressed through hostile or confrontational messaging
clashes over opposing positions or decisions
tensions or friction between parties that escalate into open dispute

concepts.definition: Educational institutions, schooling activities, education-related matters, or the social and administrative context surrounding them.
concepts.label: school
manifestations: school personnel, students, or parents in school-related roles
education-related topics such as curriculum, grades, admissions, discipline, or funding

exclusion_criteria: Mentions of school or education that do not involve any dispute, conflict, or fight
Disputes or arguments that have no connection to school, schooling, or education
Neutral or cooperative discussions about school matters with no conflict element
Passing references to school in the context of an unrelated dispute
inclusion_criteria: Evidence showing a dispute, argument, conflict, or fight where the subject matter involves a school, schooling, or education
Evidence where parties argue or clash over school-related policies, decisions, events, personnel, students, or administration
Evidence where conflict arises in the context of school activities, functions, or environments
Evidence where disagreements about education, curriculum, grades, admissions, discipline, or school governance are expressed
Evidence where school-related tensions manifest as confrontational or hostile exchanges
interpretive_assumptions: A 'fight' includes both physical altercations and verbal or written disputes, not only literal physical fights
'School' encompasses any educational institution, schooling activity, or education-related matter, not limited to a specific type or level of school
Indirect or contextual manifestations of conflict may be relevant if they materially concern school-related matters
A single exchange may qualify as a fight even if brief, provided it shows clear disagreement or hostility

retrieval_queries.text: dispute about students teachers parents school
